desc: Lists metadata for skills owned by the organization, including invite-only skills.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

category.desc: Only return skills in this category.

cursor.desc: Continuation from the previous page. Keep all filters and sorting unchanged. Pages can be empty while a continuation remains; continue until next_cursor is empty. Changes during traversal may move results; pagination is not a snapshot.

limit.desc: The maximum number of skills to return. Fewer may be returned even when more remain.

creator_ids.desc: Only return skills created by these users. Accepts U or W user IDs.

publish_status.desc: Filter by publication to the org catalog.

auto_enabled_status.desc: Filter by org deployment, independently of publication.

sort.desc: Sort across the inventory. Name uses case-insensitive ordering. Unedited skills use their creation date for date_updated sorting.

sort_dir.desc: Sort direction; file ID breaks ties.

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill.

anyOf.desc: Enumerates the categories available for organizing AI skills.

creator_id.desc: User ID of the skill's creator.

date_created.desc: Unix timestamp when the skill was created.

date_updated.desc: Unix timestamp when the skill was last updated. Null if it was never edited.

anyOf.desc: Who in the workspace can view and share this skill. Derived from the highest ORG/WORKSPACE-level access grant on the underlying skill canvas: `invite_only` when no such grant exists (only the creator and explicitly invited members), `anyone_can_view` when a read or comment grant exists, `anyone_can_edit` when a write grant exists.

visibility.desc: Org-wide visibility. Null if visibility could not be determined.

is_official.desc: Whether the skill is published to the organization's catalog.

library_count.desc: Approximate number of people who have the skill enabled.

permission_type.desc: Who receives a skill automatically. This setting does not grant access to its instructions.

usergroup_ids.desc: Deployment audience within this organization. Empty for everyone or no_one.

items.desc: Explicit metadata-only inventory projection, including invite-only skills. No access level or skill content is implied.

next_cursor.desc: Cursor for the next page. Empty on the last page.

invalid_cursor.desc: The cursor is malformed or belongs to different filters, sorting, user, or organization.

invalid_category.desc: The category isn't one of the supported skill categories.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.

restricted_action.desc: The caller must be an org admin or owner with permission to manage skills.

internal_error.desc: A lookup failed, so the page couldn't be built completely. Retry the request with the same cursor.

not_an_enterprise.desc: This method requires an Enterprise Grid organization.

skills.description: Reviews information from Slack and your calendar to suggest priorities for the day.
